scope: frozen steady-state fresh-input CPU inference for the four main learned controllers
timing_order: deterministically shuffled homogeneous groups, then reverse group order in second pass; each group block has its own warmup followed by contiguous timed calls
purpose: measure a prepared, warmed frozen model without cross-backend cache-order confounding
fresh_feature_forward: normalized contiguous float32 input -> newly computed features -> float64 CPU output; no feature lookup cache
fresh_forward_posterior_prediction: same fresh forward plus dot product with restored fixed Bayesian posterior mean
input_generation: 211 feasible local pairs, VALID_PAIRS/20; rotate 16 independent input banks inside each block; separate correctness inputs include random configurations and all local feasible pairs

selected_backends.QNN Bandit, batch1: C++ fused fixed quantum gates and readout
selected_backends.QNN Bandit, batch512: NumPy affine transforms + C++ fused quantum evolution
